name: One markdown engine, downstream of the computer text, content and data engines, owned by one markdown-engineering services section
asks: The Leader's orders of 2026-09-10 (given three times: 19:29 and then verbatim at 02:32 and 02:45 on 09-11): one set of markdown technologies, the engine chain, one owning section, all consumers on that base.

x-provenance.recorded-by: work-arena-agency pass of debt-2026-10-09-leader-words-held-in-corpus (Red Cup Engineer Senior)
x-provenance.basis: Leader utterances cited by address; the requirements are an EARS rendering of what those words state and carry no scope the words do not.

board-opening.need: One markdown engine, downstream of the computer text, content and data engines, owned by one markdown-engineering services section

requirements.says: The Group shall have exactly one set of technologies for handling markdown files, used by all software in the ecosystem.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-10: "Do not stop until we have exactly one set of technologies for handling markdown files that all software in our ecosystem uses".

requirements.says: The markdown engine shall be downstream of a computer text engine, which shall be downstream of a computer content engine, which shall be downstream of a computer data engine.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-10: "a markdown-engine downstream of a computer-text-engine downstream of a computer-content-engine downstream of a computer-data-engine, all built using our best practices".

requirements.says: The markdown-engineering services section shall own the markdown engine and the underlying source code it needs.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-10: "unifying all our existing scattered markdown code into one markdown-engineering-services-section that owns the engine and the necessary underlying source code."

requirements.says: Every consumer of markdown technologies in the ecosystem shall work from the markdown engine as its base.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-10: "all consumers of markdown technologies working from that base".

requirements.says: The markdown engine shall absorb the Group's existing scattered markdown code, including the live MetroPlat markdown codec and the capabilities the 2026-07-14 inventory found only in archived tooling.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-10: "unifying all our existing scattered markdown code"; the 2026-07-14 inventory of prior markdown software tooling lists eleven capabilities the live codec lacks.

requirements.says: The markdown engine shall be the only means by which the Group's markdown resources are written, so that the norms the Group wants are enforced at write time and do not drift.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-10: "You continue, every session, to just, Write with your tool .md files by hand, and thus the norms we want never stick, drift further and further."; "our best tooling for working with Markdown resources".

requirements.says: The markdown engine shall be built using the Group's best practices and shall let a cheaper model class write markdown notes through it.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-10: "all built using our best practices"; 2026-09-28: markdown notes "should have been delegated to a cheaper model, MONTHS ago, with our software".
